decision.basis: Subject custody held at the pinned sha256 6a134f70… and mode 0444 at both the start and the end of review, and HEAD held at c04ad230 — the same commit that parked D-272 CONTESTED, as the draft states. All 10 distinct cited digests were recomputed by hashing every file under docs/coop and docs/v2; each resolves to exactly one path and that path is exactly the one its label names, 0 mismatches and 0 collisions. The 11th cited row, HEAD, was verified separately. Every live claim is independently corroborated against file 08: required-now 28, owners 32 of 32, last gate row DR-G32, DR-118 DECIDED-V1-NOT-INTEGRATED, DR-125 OPEN, DR-107 PROPOSED-CLOSED-FOR-REVIEW intact, condition 2 at 5 of 32, condition 4 MET at 28 of 28, condition 5 last. Currency is correct in both directions and independently confirmed: I enumerated every COORD heading recording a language-quality leftover-join and found D-165 (v2), D-206 (v3) and D-272 (v5, CONTESTED, recording nothing), so leftover-join.v3 is genuinely current at draft time, non-currency is confined to after this successor is recorded, v4 has no recording at all and is correctly unqualifiedly not current and not Dual ACCEPT, and sdk leftover-join.v6 is current per D-267 with sdk v5 not current. leftoverDesign is recited as exactly the three obligations that carry leftoverDesign true in the measured subject. The branch enumeration is complete and monotonic across [237..271] with no gaps or duplicates, does not span D-236 — which is a genuine file-08 cell edit, DR-104 SATISFIED under D-056 Class B — and explicitly excludes CONTESTED D-272. The Stage A observation disposition is the load-bearing part of this draft and it is exact in both halves: three named Claude observation objects with their identifiers preserved, no observationsNotFindings field and no advisories field for Claude; an empty observationsNotFindings list, an absent observations field and zero advisories for Codex. The absence is never recast as an empty list, no Codex identifier is invented, and the draft never claims both reviewers' identifiers are preserved — nor does it copy forward D-271's 'Claude Stage A returned no observation identifiers', which would have been false here. New-cycle discipline holds structurally, not just by recital: every Stage B table, turn-landing sentence and D-272 turn-artifact row is gone, and a grep for turn-2/turn-3/MF/SF/CODEX-D272/Stage B language returns zero hits. I ran 60 attacks including four sustained attempts to convict the draft of dropping custody clauses carried by the parked cycle's turn-3 subject; each collapsed once tested against the DR-118 lineage's own adopted precedent D-206 and against clause frequency across D-240..D-271, and in every case the substance survives elsewhere in the draft.
